description.en: Radial radio wheel like in GTA V. Hold the - (minus) key in a vehicle (or on foot if radio range is set to Always), move the mouse to a station, release to tune. Type rrScan in the console to rescan stations.
description.ro: Roata radial de radio ca in GTA V. Tii apasat - (minus) intr-un vehicul (sau pe jos daca raza radio e Always), muti mouse-ul pe o statie, dai drumul ca sa o pornesti. Scrie rrScan in consola ca sa rescanezi statiile.
